g.text: Distribution of other main-benefit counts across quarters, 2008-2026
Descriptive distribution / official backcast | Student hardship and other seasonal programmes affect this category. Boxes mix
years with different policies and economic conditions; they describe seasonality, not a causal seasonal effect.
Sources: MSD working-age benefit and Jobseeker subgroup quarterly counts, June 2021-June 2026; MSD September 2013 benefit tables,
including official pre-reform backcasts to September 2008; MSD December 2018 benefit tables; December 2013-December 2018;
